label: Non-DLBCL monomorphic and Hodgkin lymphoma PTLD: clinical insights and treatment strategies.
summary: Monomorphic posttransplant lymphoproliferative disorders (PTLDs) beyond diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) are rare, biologically heterogeneous entities with limited prospective data to guide treatment. DLBCL-PTLD, which comprises most cases, is managed using approaches informed by prospective phase 2 studies, including reduction in immunosuppression and a risk-adapted sequential immunochemotherapy approach.
